设置参数`direction`控制单选框的选项排列方向。.en-us: Use `direction` to set the radio option layout direction.

设置参数`optionType='button'`时选项的渲染为按钮形式。.en-us: Set `optionType='button'` to render options as buttons.

设置参数`block=True`后单选框整体宽度将撑满父容器。.en-us: Set `block=True` to make the radio group fill its parent width.

当`optionType='button'`时，设置参数`size`控制各选项按.en-us: When `optionType='button'`, use `size` to set the option button sizes.

当`options`每个元素的`label`和`value`值相同时，可通过传入.en-us: When each option has the same `label` and `value`, pass a list of strings or numbers as a short form for `options`.

`options`中各选项的`label`支持传入组件。.en-us: The `label` of each item in `options` can be a component.
